About the Practice

Stony Brook University Hospital is Long Island's premier academic medical center and Suffolk County's only tertiary care hospital and Regional Trauma Center. [9, 10] It serves as the home to the Stony Brook University Heart Institute, Cancer Center, Children's Hospital, and Neurosciences Institute, providing exceptional healthcare, research, and clinical opportunities for patients of all ages. [9, 10] The hospital and its associated clinics offer care across more than 30 specialties. [11, 12]
